chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام:

Concerning a man who has two vessels containing water, and impurity fell into one of them, but he does not know which of the two it is, and he is not able to obtain any water other than it, he said: "He pours both of them out completely and performs tayammum."

key_terms.قَذَرٌ: Impurity or filth that contaminates the water
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: He performs tayammum as a substitute purification
key_terms.يُهَرِيقُهُمَا: He pours both of them out

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if impurity falls into one of two water containers and he does not know which one is impure?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a case of uncertain ritual impurity in two containers of water. When a person cannot determine which water has become contaminated and has no other water available, both are discarded and tayammum is performed instead.
